nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, written in approve and transferFrom.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition checks, set in _mints and read in ensure.
Externally set address whitelisted in ensure, writable only by owner through setTradeAddress.
Minimum sale amount per transfer configured by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum sale amount per transfer configured by init and enforced by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init and enforced by condition.
Per-address count of completed sales incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance lookups and transfer authorisation.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Core transfer routine performing allowance checks, ensure whitelist checks and raw balance arithmetic.
Internal whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale addresses or when condition passes.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Internal sale-limit validation reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
Privileged mint/whitelist function that sets balances and marks the spender as saleable.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits (_minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum).
Owner-only batch distribution using unchecked multiplication and subtraction on balances.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata supplied by the caller, allowing storage takeover.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath or underflow/overflow guards.
Raw total = _value * _tos.length and balance subtraction without SafeMath overflow/underflow protection.
Source address argument of transferFrom, used for allowance, ensure and balance checks.
Destination address argument of transferFrom credited in the balance mapping.
Transfer amount argument of transferFrom, directly applied to unchecked balance arithmetic.
Target address argument of delegate used as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes argument of delegate forwarded to the delegatecall.
Account argument of _mints whose balance and canSale flag are set.
Mint amount argument of _mints multiplied by 10**decimals and stored into balanceOf.
Local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from and used to look up allowance[_from][msg.sender], controlling who may move tokens.
_mints authorises minting and whitelisting based on msg.sender equalling owner or a hard-coded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing the sale limit state variables.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution from the owner balance.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before updating the trade whitelist address.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
transferFrom invokes ensure to apply the whitelist and sale condition checks.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted, gating the transfer on sale limits.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall on the caller-supplied target and payload.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with raw uint arithmetic.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it from the sender balance without SafeMath.
_mints writes canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the account for unrestricted transfers.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for both the source and destination addresses.
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each destination in the balanceOf mapping.
_mints assigns balanceOf[spender] = addedValue * 10**decimals, overwriting the existing balance.
init sets _minSale from the token argument scaled by 10**decimals.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken argument scaled by 10**decimals.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address sale counts are enforced.
condition reads _minSale to reject transfers below the configured minimum.
condition reads _maxSale to reject transfers above the configured maximum.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against the allowed sale count.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to decide whether the address bypasses the condition gate.
ensure reads tradeAddress to allow the configured trading address through.
The _from parameter flows into transferFrom for allowance lookup, ensure and balance checks.
The _to parameter flows into transferFrom as the credited destination address.
The _value parameter flows into transferFrom as the amount to move and to record.
The _value parameter is applied directly to the unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
The a parameter supplies the delegatecall target address inside delegate.
The b parameter supplies the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall inside delegate.
The spender parameter is the account whose balance and canSale entry are modified by _mints.
The addedValue parameter is scaled by 10**decimals and written to balanceOf in _mints.
The local total is used by batchSend to debit the sender balance before distribution.
The local total derives from the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length performed in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom for allowance, whitelist and balance logic.
_to is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom as the credited destination.
_value is a transient argument consumed only by transferFrom and its unchecked balance arithmetic.
a is a transient argument used only as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
b is a transient argument used only as the delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
spender is a transient argument consumed only by _mints to write balanceOf and canSale.
addedValue is a transient argument consumed only by _mints to set the minted balance.
total is a local temporary whose value is derived and consumed solely within batchSend's unchecked arithmetic.
